name: Chive noodle soup
summary: The bowl Du lịch Phú Yên treats as Tuy Hòa’s own: soft strands, sea-fish cake, and a thick cover of chives. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says it is sold all day. The food roundup lets you choose bột lọc or bột gạo. A bánh canh article from the same office says the strand is bột gạo. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Tuy Hoa. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang, its food roundup, and its article on three central bánh canh bowls all describe this one.
texture: The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says the strands are soft and not mushy. The bánh canh article says they are bột gạo, soft, chewy, and do not break in the pot. The food roundup says you can choose bột lọc or bột gạo. Both accounts stay.
taste: The bowl is chives and sea-fish cake in the same spoon. The bánh canh article says the cake is cá mối, cá cờ, or cá nhồng, pounded, shaped thick, steamed, then fried, and that the draw is the smell of the chives. The food roundup singles the hot bowl out on a cold day. A season for the chives was not printed.
howToEat: Eat it hot, chives and chả cá together. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang says the bowl is sold all day, morning or midday. The food roundup points at a cold day. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Tuy Hòa, on the Trần Hưng Đạo side of the market. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang also puts a bowl at the Ngô Quyền and Trần Hưng Đạo corner. Market hours are Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh canh he in Tuy Hoa — chives and fish cake
seoDescription: Soft strands, sea-fish cake, and chives at Cho Tuy Hoa, sold all day. One account says bot loc or bot gao. Another says bot gao. A price is Check on arrival.
